dct_creator_sm: University of Guelph, Ridgetown Campus (University of Guelph, Ridgetown Campus).
dct_description_sm: This data set contains Ontario corn grain prices collected by University of Guelph, Ridgetown Campus. The dataset includes daily prices of agricultural commodities at individual elevators in Ontario. Daily highs and lows are given for each commodity, as well as, daily Bank of Canada exchange rates.
dct_rights_sm: Access to these data is restricted to current University of Guelph faculty, students, and staff. If you are a U of G faculty, student, or staff member accessing these data from a U of G campus (including the main U of G campus, Ridgetown campus, or Guelph-Humber campus), you will have immediate access to view and download these data. If you are a U of G faculty, student, or staff member attempting to access these data while off-campus, please use the Request Access button. You will be prompted to create a repository account (if you do not already have one) based on your U of G credentials to complete the request process. Access will be granted upon review and approval.
